scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "pnpm --dir backend run dev" "pnpm --dir frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "pnpm --dir backend start" "pnpm --dir frontend run dev"
